verdict.rationale: The vendor claims layout-aware accuracy that generic OCR and PDF-to-text tools can't match, and it has published benchmarks. A hands-on re-run of the baseline code contradicts them: the user got 0.980 faithfulness versus the reported 0.667, higher than LlamaParse's own reported score, and the comparison used different retrieval pipelines. Running your own evals is feasible on the 10,000 free monthly credits, but no eval tooling or methodology is documented. missing for 10: a reproducible, documented benchmark suite with consistent baselines, official eval tooling or datasets, and independent confirmation of the accuracy claims
